Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Lanen Kesho: 28-year-old woman, 153 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: angular diamond face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; short rounded nose, wide mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
